summary_en: RSFNet is a supervised RGB-sonar fusion framework for underwater depth estimation. A geometry-aware Sonar Modality Alignment Module transforms multibeam-sonar measurements into an RGB-aligned coarse range representation, which supplies absolute-distance priors that reduce monocular scale ambiguity. The paper also contributes a Gazebo-based synthetic dataset (RSSUD) and a real water-tank dataset (RSRUD), then fuses RGB texture and sonar range features through a dual-branch encoder, multi-scale decoder, and global-context module. It is a direct camera-sonar imaging and reconstruction contribution and should be included in the core library.
